title: 28th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/28/3/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 22/3/2025 to 24/3/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request for Parliament's consent (Constitution Articles 115(p)(1) and 93(a)) for the Maldives to join the Labour Centre of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation and sign and ratify its statute is sent to the relevant standing committee.
First reading of the bill submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to amend Law No. 32/2015 (Prevention of Terrorism Act).
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominations for non-resident ambassadors of the Maldives to the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan and the State of Palestine.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominee for Ambassador of the Maldives to Japan.
Economic Committee report on the bill to amend Law No. 2/99 (Maldives Tourism Act).
Social Committee report on the Zakat Bill.
General Committee report on the proposal, under Rule 272(c) of the Standing Orders, to amend Rules 23(l) and 30(a) of the Parliament's Standing Orders.
Judiciary Committee report on the Judicial Service Commission's submission, under Constitution Article 154(b), to remove Criminal Court Judge Al-Ustaz Hussain Faiz Rashad from judicial office.
Judiciary Committee report on the bill to amend Law No. 17/2011 (Drugs Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, sent an OIC Labour Centre membership request to committee, gave first reading to a Terrorism Act amendment, and took up seven committee reports including ambassador nominees, the Zakat Bill, the Tourism and Drugs Act amendments and the removal of a Criminal Court judge.
